newsitem.title: INDIA: Two die as India police fire on striking workers.
newsitem.headline: Two die as India police fire on striking workers.

text.p: Two textile workers were shot dead and five wounded on Monday when police and striking labourers clashed in southern India, authorities said.

Police in the capital of Karnataka state, Bangalore, said more than 1,000 striking workers from a textiles mill in nearby Bidadi town blocked a busy highway. The private mill has faced labour unrest for the past five years.
Police said they tried to break up the protest with a baton charge and tear gas, and then workers tried to set vehicles on fire and attacked policemen, prompting them to shoot.
Two workers died on the way to hospital while five others were admitted to Bangalore hospital with bullet wounds, a senior police officer said.
